@djoshy: This pull request references [MCO-2155](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/MCO-2155) which is a valid jira issue.

Warning: The referenced jira issue has an invalid target version for the target branch this PR targets: expected the story to target the "4.22.0" version, but no target version was set.

<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/machine-config-operator/pull/5799):

>I missed a couple of tests in my previous attempt(https://github.com/openshift/machine-config-operator/pull/5784), this PR fixes that. Also, @sergiordlr reminded me that extended-priv should not directly use the API via clients and should try to use `oc` instead. I have updated the new function(`SkipIfUnsupportedOSStreamLabel`) we added in #5784 to account for this pattern.
>
>Existing bootimage tests should continue to pass, additional QE should not be needed. 
>


Instructions for interacting with me using PR comments are available [here](https://prow.ci.openshift.org/command-help?repo=openshift%2Fmachine-config-operator).  If you have questions or suggestions related to my behavior, please file an issue against the [openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin](https://github.com/openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin/issues/new) repository.
</details>

## Walkthrough Added an OS stream label support gate to two automatic-mode test paths and refactored cluster utility helpers to detect unsupported OS stream labels via `oc` CLI list calls instead of using the machine clientset. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Test Precondition Gate**
`test/extended-priv/mco_bootimages_skew.go`|Inserted `SkipIfUnsupportedOSStreamLabel(oc.AsAdmin())` into the "Verify Automatic mode and Upgradeable" Happy and Sad Case flows, running after the supported-platform filter and before `machineConfiguration.RemoveSkew()` and subsequent status assertions.| |**Utility Function Refactor**
`test/extended-priv/util/clusters.go`|Removed direct machine clientset usage; reimplemented `SkipIfUnsupportedOSStreamLabel` and `SkipIfCPMSHasUnsupportedOSStreamLabel` to call `oc get ... -n openshift-machine-api` with a negative label selector (`machineconfiguration.openshift.io/osstream != rhel-9`) and skip the test if any resource names are returned. Adjusted error handling to assert `oc` list success (`Expect(err).NotTo(HaveOccurred())`) instead of the prior early-return behavior.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~12 minutes
✨ Finishing Touches
🧪 Generate unit tests (beta) - [ ] Create PR with unit tests
